'''Kuati anarchist group''' was a resistance movement during [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

==History==
A group of anarchists from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] formed a movement aimed at opposing the [[Kuat City]] [[Baron/Legends|barons]], who were exploiting the planet's inhabitants as slaves in their [[Factory/Legends|factories]]. Following the death of his son, [[Larbo]], the group's leader, organized a large number of men and equipment, who were housed in a camp located in the [[Forest/Legends|forest]].<ref name="Tales18" />
[[File:KDY.svg|left|thumb|[[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] owners of the all factories from the planet Kuat.]]
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="BGDate" /> [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] tasked [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] with [[Mission to Kuat (Jango Fett)|eliminating]] anarchists on the planet Kuat, who posed a threat to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|plans]] and the emerging [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Jango Fett sent his son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to an anarchist camp to trap the entire group. Boba Fett used a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] to create chaos in the camp, and Jango then emerged from the [[Bush/Legends|bushes]] to eliminate each target. Larbo abducted young Boba Fett into a tent, using him as a hostage. After eliminating everyone except Larbo, Jango Fett ordered him to release his son or he would die, but the group leader refused the offer and paid with his life.<ref name="Tales18" />
